rationale: Independent reading: held EO 13824 (83 FR 8923) revokes EO 13545 and rewrites EO 13265 for the President's Council on Sports, Fitness, and Nutrition; held EO 14327 (90 FR 37993, July 31, 2025) sec. 1 'Executive Order 13824 of February 26, 2018 (President's Council on Sports, Fitness, and Nutrition), is hereby revoked.' and sec. 2 re-amends EO 13265 by its own text. No savings clause. Refutation attempts: verified quote; whole revocation; no own term (2-year member terms are not an order term). D6: EO 14048 (2021) continued/amended EO 13265 advisory committee provisions before the revocation and does not end or extend EO 13824 beyond 2025; corpus search finds no held order naming EO 13824 after July 2025 (EO 9383/9384/9805 hits are FR page numbers). No later event ignored. NO upheld. Minor: the producer's description of EO 14048's citation (sec. 7) was not separately confirmed in the held OCR; non-fatal.
